design: Freeze H598 coefficient map K, new64 basis and H584 number direction. Reuse H597 noun inventory but rotate attractor pairings and use two new wording families: near/could observe and in front of/will examine. Both number factors and three frames. Doses 0.0625 and 0.5. Full/unchanged, Euclidean projection, frozen metric and per-case oracle. No refit or filtering. Primary comparison is metric versus Euclidean margin and KL in every cell; report failures.
gate: Per type/frame and attractor number: >=4 pairs, >=75% both-endpoint candidate correctness, >=50% intended-group full-vocabulary top1. Report all cells; failures remain in interventions.
scope: New prompt combinations after freezing K; familiar lexical inventory, not an independent lexical holdout or training-data novelty. Same number task and operation. Oracle is diagnostic; fixed coefficients use K dc only. New wording and dose transfer do not establish unrelated-task generality.
